name: Sibyl's Laurel Draught
description: A green tincture sealed with wax from a hut that should be empty.
benefit: Shows the next turn of a conversation or fight before it happens.
cost: The vision costs a day of memory you will not get back.

name: Coin of the Last Favour
description: A worn obol pressed into a palm at a dying request.
benefit: Calls in one favour from a stranger who owes the dying.
cost: The favour is entered against your own name.

name: Vial of Styx Water
description: Cold water that does not warm in the hand.
benefit: Binds one promise so that the other party cannot break it.
cost: You are bound by the same promise, to the letter.

name: Charon's Fare Wafer
description: A thin wafer stamped with a boatman's face.
benefit: Pays one crossing of any water or gate of the dead.
cost: You return lighter by the memory of someone living.

name: Huntress's Hush Tallow
description: A pot of rendered fat from an animal no one saw die.
benefit: Silences footsteps and scent for a short while.
cost: Game flees you for a day afterwards.

name: Pouch of Orichalcum Filings
description: Red-gold dust that stings the nose.
benefit: Restores a spent charge in one tool or weapon.
cost: The dust leaves a bright burn in the lungs.

name: Pinch of Omen Ash
description: Burned entrails ground fine and kept in a quill.
benefit: Warns of the next ambush on this road.
cost: The warning is always true, even when you would rather it were not.

name: Grave-Bread Loaf
description: A dense loaf left on a barrow stone for the dead.
benefit: Feeds a party for a day and quiets a restless shade.
cost: Taking it leaves a debt owed to the unburied.

name: Burning Red Clew
description: A red thread that unwinds as you walk and burns away at the end.
benefit: Shows the way back out of a maze or dungeon.
cost: The thread is spent, and so is your chance to get lost on purpose.

name: Initiate's Barley Cup
description: A shallow clay cup stained with the kykeon.
benefit: Lets you walk as an initiate into any hall of the mysteries once.
cost: The secrets you learn cannot be told, and the silence is heavy.

name: Seer's Censer Shard
description: A cracked bowl that still smells of laurel smoke.
benefit: Oracles speak plainly to the bearer.
cost: Plain speech is rarely kind, and you will hear all of it.

name: Oathkeeper's Lamp
description: A bronze lamp lit only when a promise is kept.
benefit: Lights the dark whenever you keep a spoken word.
cost: Goes cold for a week after you break one.

name: Page of the Last Favour
description: A single sheet with a list of those who owe a king.
benefit: Your debts to the dead weigh less than they should.
cost: Every page torn from the ledger is noticed by someone.

name: Underworld Pass Token
description: A black token the keeper of the gate does not ask for twice.
benefit: Shades will speak with you and not follow you home.
cost: The living find you cold company.

name: Huntress's Bow Cord
description: A cord plucked from a goddess's own bow.
benefit: Every arrow loosed lands a little truer.
cost: Game that has been wronged will find you.

name: Orichalcum Tuning Fork
description: A forked rod of red metal that rings by itself.
benefit: Finds a vein of orichalcum underfoot.
cost: The ring can be heard from far away.

name: Prophet's Tally Bone
description: A rib scored with marks no one remembers cutting.
benefit: Those who were told of you count your deeds in your favour.
cost: The tally includes what you have not yet done.

name: Miasma Veil Pin
description: A pin fastened through a stained veil.
benefit: Walk through polluted ground without sickness.
cost: The veil clings to you and takes a slot you would rather use.

name: Barrow Warden's Bell
description: A flat bronze bell hung from a grave post.
benefit: Rouses no sleeper within a barrow while you carry it.
cost: The bell cannot be muffled and every living thing hears it.

name: Synod Scribe's Stylus
description: A bone stylus used to minute the leagues' agreements.
benefit: What you write down in a sanctuary is treated as binding.
cost: Anything you write in a sanctuary binds you as well.

name: Daedalus's Hinge Pin
description: A tiny hinge pin from a door that opens to somewhere else.
benefit: Shortcuts through a maze are always a little shorter for the bearer.
cost: The shortcut leads to the wrong place half the time.

name: Wreath of the Mystai
description: Dried barley and myrtle bound in a ring.
benefit: Dreams show you one truth of the place you sleep in.
cost: Dreams leave you tired and unsure of the waking world.

name: Coil of the Sundered Rope
description: A coil cut from a bridge no one will cross again.
benefit: Ropes and bridges never fail under the bearer.
cost: The coil is heavy, and it never comes loose from the pack.

name: Laurel Shrine Key
description: A key of green bronze cast in the shape of a laurel leaf.
benefit: Opens the sealed door of a laurel shrine.
cost: The seer inside will not suffer further visitors.

name: Thesauros Vault Key
description: A heavy key with a pierced bow, warm from some old hand.
benefit: Opens the strong room of a treasury kept by the last favour.
cost: The vault shows only what is owed, not what it holds.

name: Nekyomanteion Gate Key
description: A black key that is cold and strangely light.
benefit: Unlocks the deepest door of the oracle of the dead.
cost: The door will not open again behind you.

name: Huntress Shrine Latch
description: A carved antler latch worn smooth by many palms.
benefit: Opens the barred shrine of a withdrawn goddess.
cost: You are watched the whole way in.

name: Ridge Fortress Postern Key
description: A long iron key stamped with a mine's mark.
benefit: Opens the postern of a fortress above an orichalcum seam.
cost: Anyone who sees it will know it is stolen.

name: Omen Stone Cleft Pin
description: A bronze wedge that fits the crack in a standing stone.
benefit: Opens the cleft in an omen stone and shows what is within.
cost: What it shows cannot be unseen.

name: Purification Spring Valve
description: A bronze valve that fits no pipe in any town.
benefit: Opens the sluice of a sealed purification spring.
cost: The first draw is always foul.

name: Oath Stone Token
description: A flat stone cut to fit a gap in the stone of oaths.
benefit: Opens the chamber beneath an oath stone.
cost: Whoever entered last swore never to let it be opened.

name: Synod Hall Lantern Key
description: A slim key hung from a lantern ring.
benefit: Opens the closed hall of a synod.
cost: The synod counts the hours you spend inside.

name: Telesterion Door Key
description: A key of dark wood scored with barley ears.
benefit: Opens the inner door of the telesterion.
cost: You are sworn to silence about what lies inside.

name: Barrow Capstone Wedge
description: A stone wedge that lifts a capstone as a key lifts a latch.
benefit: Opens the sealed chamber of a barrow.
cost: What sleeps there knows your name afterwards.

name: Rope Bridge Winch Key
description: A crank key that fits the winch of a bridge long cut.
benefit: Lowers a rope bridge that was raised against all comers.
cost: A lowered bridge is a bridge for everyone.
